key: KXAIRDROPMONAD|Will Monad conduct an airdrop before Oct 1, 2025?|If Monad conducts an airdrop before Oct 1, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes. An airdrop is defined as the distribution of fungible tokens to multiple wallet addresses where recipients receive tokens without paying the full market value. This includes free distributions requiring only gas fees, distributions requiring donations less than 10% of market value, retroactive rewards, task-based distributions, and phased distributions where initial tokens are received before the deadline. Token sales where recipients pay 10% or more of market value, ICOs, IDOs, employee compensation, liquidity mining rewards, staking rewards, NFTs, non-transferable tokens, and unconverted points do not constitute airdrops. The airdrop must be conducted (tokens actually distributed) before the deadline, not merely announced.
reasoning: Monad did not conduct an airdrop before October 1, 2025. The airdrop was announced on October 14, 2025, and tokens were actually distributed on November 24, 2025, both after the deadline. The resolution criteria explicitly requires tokens to be "actually distributed" before the deadline, not merely announced.
